sources.quote: It is an adaptation of the 1902 Sherlock Holmes story The Hound of the Baskervilles by Arthur Conan Doyle.

sources.story: The Adventure of the Empty House
sources.quote: Inspired by "The Adventure of the Empty House" and "The Lost Special" by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, the episode follows Sherlock Holmes' return to London and reunion with John Watson, along with an underground terrorist network.

other_sources: The Lost Special (Conan Doyle short story)
